This seems like a lot of work for a skimming setup. The skimmers are so small you can put them over just about any card reader without making a giant replica of the front plate of an ATM. You can be sure anyone who's put this setup together has easy access to this specific brand of ATM though.

Having something in front of the reader might raise more suspicion than if it looks like the whole thing is unmodified. Not to mention just a skimmer won't provide you with the PIN.

And I'm not sure if this one was that advanced; but having a whole fake front would possibly allow them to operate the real ATM with the intercepted data as the user uses it, making it even harder to detect.
In countries where this was a real problem the majority of ATMs now use scanners with extruding asymmetric circular ports so you can't just strap a thin skimmer on the top of the reader.
